Name: Tree Spread
Author: bcmpinc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Prevents trees from automatically dropping their seeds and spreading on your farm. To compensate, trees will have a higher chance of having a seed.
Furthermore trees on your farm will retain their seed during the night.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[i]Note: run Stardew Valley once with this mod enabled to generate the [code]config.json[/code] file.[/i][list]
[*] [code]SeedChance[/code]: Chance that a tree will have a seed. Normally this is 0.05 (=5%). Default = 0.15 (=15%).
[*] [code]OnlyPreventTapped[/code]: Whether only tapped trees are prevented from dropping seeds. Default = false.
[*] [code]RetainSeed[/code]: Whether the tree should keep its seed during the night, to compensate for trees not spreading. Vanilla SDV removes seeds during the night. Default = true.
[/list][size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
[/list][size=4][b]Known bugs[/b][/size]
Please report bugs on [url=https://github.com/bcmpinc/StardewHack/issues]GitHub[/url].
